objection.quote: We need to show that with Liu's initial partition (n pieces size 2d, one size d), Xiang cannot force Liu below (n+1)d.
objection.witness: A valid lower bound must give the correct all-n construction and prove it against every allocation of Xiang's at most n cuts. The text proves an invariance only when every 2d piece is split once, then explicitly leaves unproved the cases where cuts are distributed differently; moreover, it targets the incorrect value (n+1)/(2n+1).
objection.load_bearing: The claimed guarantee depends entirely on excluding arbitrary Xiang replies that distribute multiple cuts in one Liu interval or leave other intervals uncut. That exclusion is never established.
